title: Label the cell verify field as MAIN's command at the read moment
action: OBSERVED DEFECT (main-diagnosed, live 2026-07-28): under R82 (main-verifies) a worker still ran the whole suite chain. Cause is signal conflict, not disobedience — the worker's skill says cap via --feature-verify-pending, but `cells show` hands it a field literally named `verify` containing a ready-to-run command with no owner label, and its dispatch prompt's 'run no suites' line loses to the artifact's own wording. FIX, three parts: (1) packages/bee/bee.mjs `cells show`: when rendering a cell (both human and --json paths), carry an explicit owner annotation for the verify command — in JSON add a sibling key `verify_owner` with the exact value 'main (feature close) — the worker never runs this' whenever the repo is under the feature-verify law (i.e. always, now), and in the human render print the verify line with that suffix. Do NOT rename or remove the `verify` field itself (cell schema, planning contract, and every existing cell depend on it). (2) packages/bee/lib/command-registry.mjs: the cells.show description and any cells.add/update parameter description for `verify` states in one clause that this command is MAIN's, run once at feature close, never by the assigned worker. (3) skills/bee-executing/SKILL.md: one line in the worker loop making it unmissable — 'The cell's `verify` field is MAIN's command, not yours: never run it, never quote its output as your evidence.' Body budget 9227 recorded — net-zero-or-negative, trim to pay. R82 applies to you: run NO test suites; cap --feature-verify-pending; MAIN verifies at close.

truths: cells show --json carries verify_owner with the exact sentence; human render shows the same ownership suffix beside the verify command.
The `verify` field itself is unchanged in name, position and value (no schema break).
Registry descriptions for cells.show and the verify parameter state MAIN ownership.
bee-executing carries the one-line never-run rule; its body did not grow past 9227B.
prohibitions: Do NOT rename or drop the verify field.
Do NOT make cap refuse when a worker did run a verify (classic path stays legal).
Do NOT run any test suite (R82).

verify: node packages/bee/tests/test_bee_cli.mjs && node scripts/skill_budget_fence.mjs && node scripts/skill_lint.mjs
regen_obligation_ack: wave-barrier: regen deferred to orchestrator at feature close (parallel-default D2)
